title: cistus × florentinus var. olbiensis
intro: Cistus × florentinus var. olbiensis, commonly known as the Corsican Rock Rose or more specifically, 'Corsican Rock Rose' is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Cistus genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Cistus × florentinus var. olbiensis include its potential to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
